I need to establish the high-level strategy for the phased migration. The core of my role as the Strategist in this initial step is to define the "how" and "when" of the migration waves. A 24-hour timeline for 100 services is extremely aggressive, so a clear, structured plan is critical for success.

I will create a detailed wave-based migration plan. This plan will break down the 100 microservices into manageable chunks, or "waves," with specific time allocations, service counts, and objectives for each. This approach allows the team to test and refine the process on lower-risk services first before moving to more critical systems, thereby minimizing the risk of widespread disruption.
